---
name: repo-explore
description: Build a bounded, evidence-based map of a repository before changing code.
---

1. Check the current branch, worktree status, recent history, and active worktrees.
2. Identify manifests, entry points, source roots, configuration, and tests.
3. Read applicable instructions and the nearest relevant documentation.
4. Search for the requested behavior, implementation, callers, and tests.
5. Trace only the relevant execution path and record unknowns.
6. Reuse cached project context and inspect only deltas since the last known revision.
7. Return likely files, invariants, validation commands, and risks before editing.
